decision.explanation: Two distinct but conflicting dates—June 19, 1910 (D1S1) and January 1, 1900 (D2S1)—are directly stated as the birth date of Justice Roland Almon Ritchie in separate documents. Both are valid referents under the same entity (E0), and neither is excluded by the audit. The third candidate, '13 Apr 1947,' refers to a different individual named John Ritchie (E1) and is correctly marked as irrelevant.
